snippet.title: Sale a Devolver - Official Trailer | Free Demo November 6th
snippet.description:
Your mother has given you an ultimatum: either you work or you leave. You join a management office where the previous employee has mysteriously disappeared. You handle files, deal with Don Anselmo, pet the office dog and survive the bureaucracy. Will you follow the law, or not?

📁 Download the free demo on 6 November on Itch.io.
